ASCII only, and no BOM on THIS file: PS 5.1 reads a BOM-less file as ANSI and a non-ASCII
byte in it matches nothing, silently (CLAUDE.md 0.2). The RECORDING itself keeps its BOM,
deliberately -- real line 1 carries one, and that is the GateHook incident's own artefact in
`classifies_as` is what gives WireCorpusTests teeth. It is the pane_events kind the real
parser produced for that shape when the recording was replayed, or `(no pane row)` where it
deliberately produced none. Change a `case` in LaneRuntime.HandleShimLine and the replay
stops matching this file, at a line number.
